preconditions.description: The length of the permutations n must be between 1 and 2000.
Both permutations p and s must have exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in p) and all(1 <= x <= n for x in s)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutations p and s must be integers from 1 to n.
Permutations p and s must contain the same elements.

postconditions.description: The first line of output must be the minimum number of coins required.
The second line of output must be the number of operations k.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(i) <= n and 1 <= int(j) <= n and i != j for i, j in operations)
postconditions.description: Each operation must involve valid indices i and j within the range 1 to n, and i must not equal j.
